```python
def diagonal_sum_total(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    total = 0
    # Main diagonal (top-left to bottom-right)
    for i in range(n):
        total += grid[i][i]
    # Anti-diagonal (top-right to bottom-left)
    for i in range(n):
        total += grid[i][n - 1 - i]
    # If grid has odd size, subtract the center cell once (it was counted twice)
    if n % 2 == 1:
        total -= grid[n // 2][n // 2]
    return total
```
